## Review checklist
- [ ] I have thoroughly reviewed my code and can explain what it does.
- [ ] I have run `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy`.
- [ ] If I'm introducing changes to the server router, the DB handler, or any other core features, I am including tests for these changes.
- [ ] My changes are focused and specific to an existing or new feature.
- [ ] If my changes alter usage or configuration for Main Serve in any way, I have also updated the [documentation](../docs/CONFIGURATION.md).
- [ ] I am NOT including changes that aren't described above.
